aggregation.energy: Unchanged RESULT mean and MCSE, data averaged over three hypotheses; data=wave+2*integral+0.25*carrier.
aggregation.paired: Per-bank contrasts saved in BANK_*.json; differences are taken before MCSE. Every bank value matched RESULT.
aggregation.geometry: 8 existing banks, 128 generated rows per state per bank. Flag count denominator is generated row occurrences, not distinct parents. Rate MCSE=sample_std(bank_rate,ddof=1)/sqrt(8).
aggregation.negative_area: Per-bank arithmetic mean over 128 row negative areas, then equal mean over 8 banks. MCSE across the 8 bank means.
aggregation.B_voltage_RMS: head_scales.B_voltage_RMS.RMS within each bank (across rows/bases/time), then mean and MCSE across 8 banks; plot converts volts to mV.
aggregation.B_over_A: head_scales.B_RMS_over_A_RMS.RMS within each bank: RMS across per-row RMS(B)/RMS(A) ratios; then equal bank mean. This is not ratio of the two aggregate RMS values.
aggregation.charge: Bar height is head_scales.charge_log_variance.mean per bank, then mean and MCSE over 8 banks; this is mean ||v||^2, the row-conditional log(alpha) variance. Tick labels use head_scales.charge_v_norm.RMS per bank, then bank mean. Logvariance RMS is separately saved and is not used as the bar height.
aggregation.features: Receipt-only: for each bank, arithmetic mean of its two saved same_forward_feature_RMS entries; then mean and MCSE across 8 banks. No global feature explosion claim.
aggregation.weighted_Af_minus_A0: Unchanged paired data component differences with original weights 1,2,0.25. Total data MCSE is taken from the saved paired total, not from an independent-error sum of component MCSEs.
aggregation.uncertainty: All error bars are plus/minus one MCSE, not 95-percent intervals or experimental uncertainty. Banks were examined in response033; not a fresh holdout.
aggregation.A_only: Data energy only; no full total or regular is imputed.

evidence_limits.interpretation: Parameter-block effects include changed features/amplitude and nonlinear observation. A-only marginal fit is not a conditional-mean truth test. No hard-FD/STE-gradient conclusion is established.

visual_QA.method: Both final PNGs opened via view_image after requested charge-scale and component-contrast revision.
checks: Six-state primary data energies and paired contrasts are readable.
The A0-to-Af strip shows original-weight wave/carrier conflict; total data MCSE uses paired data, not independent component errors.
Charge bars use row-mean logvariance (MfRf 0.4222713432557222); logvariance RMS is not conflated with mean.
v norm labels and B physical RMS/B:A definitions are legible; decoded/pooled are receipt-only.
All error bars are plus/minus one MCSE; existing033 TRAIN banks are explicit and not fresh holdout.
Peak-outside numerators use 1024 generated row occurrences per state, not 1024 unique parents; pure-A counts are zero.
No A-only full total is constructed; interaction is a difference of differences; no training-history causal or global-feature-explosion claim.
